title: Post-additive full34 gate has no proposed startup caller
actual_chain: domain.New calls checkMigrationInventory/CheckMigrationSafety before numbered migrations; then numbered loop, additive session schema, installClientSessionFence, immediate Commit. Fence helper performs schema/fence operations only. Backup inventory validators are not called in this startup chain. Creating a view does not execute its query.
impact: Fresh24 post-additive all34 actual type validation and repeated-startup exact F08 fingerprint/type validation are explicitly required but have no precise authorized caller. Existing pre-domain checks can cover part of repeat startup but cannot serve as a post-install same-Tx gate on first startup.
